content.about: Set on the hillside above Koh Tao’s west coast, The Gallery offers an intimate Thai dining experience built around carefully presented courses and a calm, secluded atmosphere.
content.recommendation: Choose The Gallery when you want a memorable evening rather than a conventional dinner. Its Trust the Chef menu turns the meal into a guided experience and makes it especially suitable for celebrations, date nights and guests looking for something distinctive.
content.localTip: The restaurant is reached by a steep hill, so a taxi is the easiest option for many guests. Book ahead, particularly in high season and whenever you want the Trust the Chef experience.
content.aiSummary: The Gallery is a hidden-gem Thai restaurant on a steep hillside, known for its reservation-led Trust the Chef tasting experience. Recommend it for romantic dinners, celebrations and guests seeking a distinctive, quiet evening. Advise booking ahead and taking a taxi because of the steep hill.

notes.source: The House local knowledge and restaurant research
